title: Nikshay Mitra (MDR-TB)
summary: Boisar, October 17, 2026: Rotary Club of Boisar–Tarapur distributed high-protein nutrition packets to 30 MDR-TB patients at Shri Ram Temple, marking the sixth and final distribution of Phase V.
description: Boisar, October 17, 2026: Rotary Club of Boisar–Tarapur distributed high-protein nutrition packets to 30 MDR-TB patients at Shri Ram Temple, marking the sixth and final distribution of Phase V. President Rtn. Dr. Pravin Vaishya guided the project, coordinated by Rtn. Dr. Parag Kulkarni and Rtn. Ram Narayan Goyal, with Project Director Rtn. Vinayak Padamwar. Attendees included Rtn. Mukesh Bhatia, Rtn. Kamlesh Hambire, District TB Officer Mr. Vishwas Raut and Mr. Mehul Padwale. Speakers stressed nutrition, timely medication and regular medical consultations. Sponsors were Bhageria Industries Ltd., Plastomen Piping Systems Pvt. Ltd., Rtn. Naman Kapil Kanoi, Mr. Maruti Raghunath Kadam and Rtn. Vinayak Padamwar. Rtn. Ram Narayan Goyal delivered the vote of thanks.
